name: ITSM & Service Desk Command Center
description: Accelerates incident triage with business-elapsed SLA breach tracking and spike clustering, scores CAB change requests against freeze windows and blast radius, and mines resolved tickets for Problem candidates and KCS deflection savings.

skills.summary: Computes business-elapsed vs wall-clock SLA risk, clusters correlated incident spikes by CI and error signature, and ranks matching runbooks.
Scores ServiceNow and Jira change requests across blast radius, freeze-window collisions, rollback validation, CI failure history, and CAB tier.
Groups repeat resolved tickets into Problem candidates, calculates MTTR and annualized L1 deflection savings, and validates KCS draft completeness.

connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Query active ServiceNow incidents (sysparm_display_value=all), CAB changes, and CMDB CIs, Jira issues, and Confluence KCS runbooks via remote_cli mcp (capped to targeted batch lookups) before Python SLA clustering and CAB scoring.

gateway_approval_actions: Reassigning P1/P2 incidents or updating ServiceNow/Jira tickets in bulk
Approving or rejecting CAB change requests in ServiceNow
Publishing KCS knowledge articles to external service portals in Confluence or ServiceNow
python_code_guardrails: ServiceNow state=8 canceled exclusion and business_elapsed_minutes vs wall-clock SLA enforcement
CAB freeze-window collision, missing backout-plan verification, and blast-radius risk scoring
Single-pass multi-tab workbook and capped <=3 ITSM/KB search execution discipline

scheduled_routine.name: hourly-sla-breach-watch
scheduled_routine.title: Hourly SLA Breach Watch
scheduled_routine.instruction: Execute hourly incident triage and SLA breach scan via scripts/sla_cluster_triage.py. Highlight active P1/P2 tickets above 75% business-elapsed SLA budget, flag emerging CI/error spike clusters, and recommend top matching runbooks without mutating ticket assignments automatically.
